prayerExcerpt.en-US: "I have seen and read nothing to compare with what God has shown me since I became blind."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Nada vi nem li que se compare ao que Deus me fez ver desde que fiquei cego."

meta.face: A Provençal of about fifty-five with a warm olive complexion and a LONG, RECTANGULAR face under a high forehead, where the dark, grey-streaked hair RECEDES at the temples and is cut short — level dark brows, HEAVY, HALF-LOWERED upper lids over dark eyes cast down (he became blind), a long, straight nose whose tip DIPS a little, flat, hollow-shadowed cheeks below high cheekbones, a FULL lower lip under a thick dark MOUSTACHE that droops at the corners, and a NARROW jaw, the grey-streaked beard trimmed CLOSE on the cheeks and gathered into a SHORT POINT at the chin; the expression inward and peaceful. Not the full, square-jawed beard of camillus.
meta.basis: The anonymous portrait of about 1607 in the Musée Carnavalet and the engraved portrait of about 1726 (Rijksmuseum) agree: a long face with receding dark hair, heavy half-lowered lids, a long nose, a drooping moustache and a short pointed beard, in a black soutane with a white collar, hands joined. The Dicastery's biography says he went blind in later life and kept preaching and confessing.
meta.excerpt: His often-repeated saying «Non ho visto né letto nulla a confronto di ciò che Dio mi ha fatto vedere da quando sono cieco», in the Dicastery's biography (French in the diocese of Avignon's page); our rendering (he died in 1607)
